svg.title: InsightPilot - UML class diagram of the services
svg.text: UML class diagram - services: who resolves, plans, executes, verifies and composes
plan: Plan (approved) · state: RunState · budget / cost_spent · retry_cap: int
every StepResult returns here; agents never call each other
+ run(plan) · + dispatch(step): StepResult · + compose_answer(): Answer · + halt(reason) · + replan() [295B]
Flow: resolve terms → synthesise plan → analyst approval → dispatch steps → StepResult → verify (SQL) → record Hop → compose_answer (small model via ModelClient) → Answer.
Checks never use a model: HopVerifier and CrossSourceReconciler issue independent SQL through SourceConnector. Answer text is written only from verified hops, each sentence citing its hop.
